scanNote:
WORKBOOK 7-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (30-bet). Yuqorida to'q sariq yorliqda 'UNIT 7', yonida katta qora 'Profiles'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Vocabulary':
1) 'Look at the picture and label the parts of the body with words from the list.' Qiya: 'knee, ankle, finger, ear, arm, head, hand, wrist, foot, shoulder, elbow, leg'. SURAT: futbol formasidagi qiz, oyog'i to'p ustida, qo'llari belida. 12 raqamli katakcha: 1 bosh, 2 quloq, 3 yelka, 4 qo'l (yuqori), 5 tirsak, 6 bilak, 7 qo'l panjasi, 8 barmoq (belidagi), 9 tizza (to'pdagi oyoq), 10 oyoq (boldir), 11 to'piq, 12 oyoq panjasi.
2) 'Which of the items in Ex. 1 can you break, sprain, hurt or cut?' JADVAL: break / sprain / hurt / cut.

O'NG USTUN:
3) 'Fill in the correct preposition from the list.' Qiya: 'ahead, at, into, down, in, on, for, to, over, from'. 1 There are a lot of hospitals and clinics ...... the area. 2 ...... first, the doctor was worried that the cut would not heal properly. 3 The doctor told him to return ...... the hospital for a check-up. 4 I have had a bad cold ...... the last two weeks. 5 That student has a good career ...... of him. 6 My doctor wrote ...... the medicines I had to buy. 7 John had chickenpox and had spots all ...... his body. 8 Make sure you keep all medicines away ...... children. 9 The nurse comes ...... duty at ten o'clock. 10 The scientists are doing research ...... the causes of cancer.
4) 'What's wrong with each person? Match the prompts to the pictures, then use them to write short dialogues, as in the example.' Qiya: 'get/toothache, burn/finger, break/leg, catch/cold, get/stomach ache, get/cough'. 6 RASM: 1 yo'talayotgan ayol; 2 dazmol qilayotgan erkak barmog'ini kuydirdi; 3 televizor oldida kresloda o'tirgan erkak, oyog'i gipsda; 4 qornini ushlagan ayol; 5 yuzini (jag'ini) ushlagan erkak; 6 burnini artayotgan ayol. 1 A: What's wrong? B: I've got a cough. 2-6 bo'sh.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '30'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture and label the parts of the body with words from the list: knee, ankle, finger, ear, arm, head, hand, wrist, foot, shoulder, elbow, leg.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang va tana a'zolarini ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan nomlang: knee, ankle, finger, ear, arm, head, hand, wrist, foot, shoulder, elbow, leg.
exercises.explanationUz:
TANA A'ZOLARI (coursebook 48-bet
  1-mashq).

  1 head - bosh
  2 ear - quloq
  3 shoulder - yelka
  4 arm - qo'l (yelkadan bilakkacha)
  5 elbow - tirsak
  6 wrist - bilak (qo'l bo'g'imi)
  7 hand - qo'l panjasi
  8 finger - barmoq
  9 knee - tizza
  10 leg - oyoq (sondan to'piqqacha)
  11 ankle - to'piq
  12 foot - oyoq panjasi


⚠ ARM vs HAND:

  arm = butun qo'l
  hand = panja (barmoqli qism)
  ⚠ O'zbekchada ikkalasi 'qo'l'!


⚠ LEG vs FOOT:

  leg = butun oyoq
  foot = oyoq panjasi
  ⚠ foot → ko'plik FEET.


⚠ 'KNEE':

  /niː/ - 'k' O'QILMAYDI.


⚠ 'WRIST':

  /rɪst/ - 'w' O'QILMAYDI.

exercises.instructionEn: Which of the items in Ex. 1 can you break, sprain, hurt or cut?
exercises.instructionUz: 1-mashqdagi qaysi a'zolarni sindirish, chiqarish, shikastlash yoki kesish mumkin?
exercises.explanationUz:
JAROHAT FE'LLARI:

  BREAK (sindirmoq) - suyak:
    arm, leg, wrist, finger, ankle
  SPRAIN (chiqarmoq, cho'zmoq) -
    bo'g'im: ankle, wrist, knee
  HURT (shikastlamoq, og'ritmoq) -
    HAMMASI: head, ear, shoulder,
    arm, elbow, wrist, hand,
    finger, knee, leg, ankle, foot
  CUT (kesmoq) - teri:
    finger, hand, foot, knee, arm,
    leg

  ⚠ Bir a'zo bir nechta ustunda
  bo'lishi mumkin.


⚠ 'TO SPRAIN':

  = bo'g'imni chiqarmoq (cho'zmoq).
  'a sprained ankle' = chiqqan
  to'piq.


⚠ 'TO HURT':

  = og'ritmoq / og'rimoq. 'My
  head hurts' = boshim og'riyapti.

finger, hand, foot, knee, arm, leg
pairs.rightUz: barmoq, qo'l panjasi, oyoq panjasi, tizza, qo'l, oyoq

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition from the list: ahead, at, into, down, in, on, for, to, over, from.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan to'g'ri predlogni qo'ying: ahead, at, into, down, in, on, for, to, over, from.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR (coursebook 49-bet
  6-mashq - 'Working with the Sick'
  matnidan).

  IN the area      - hududda
  AT first         - avvaliga
  return TO        - ... ga qaytmoq
  FOR the last two weeks -
    davomiylik
  a career AHEAD of him - oldinda
  write DOWN       - yozib olmoq
  all OVER his body - butun tanasi
    bo'ylab
  keep away FROM   - ... dan uzoq
    tutmoq
  come ON duty     - navbatchilikka
    kelmoq
  research INTO    - ... bo'yicha
    tadqiqot


⚠ 'TO HEAL':

  = bitmoq (yara).


⚠ 'A CHECK-UP':

  = tibbiy ko'rik.


⚠ 'CHICKENPOX':

  = suvchechak. 'spots' = dog'lar,
  toshmalar.


⚠ 'ON DUTY':

  = navbatchilikda.


⚠ 'CANCER':

  = saraton (rak).

items.sentence: There are a lot of hospitals and clinics ___ the area.
items.uz: Hududda ko'plab kasalxona va klinikalar bor.

items.sentence: ___ first, the doctor was worried that the cut would not heal properly.
items.uz: Avvaliga shifokor kesilgan joy to'g'ri bitmaydi deb xavotirlandi.

items.sentence: The doctor told him to return ___ the hospital for a check-up.
items.uz: Shifokor unga ko'rik uchun kasalxonaga qaytishni aytdi.

items.sentence: I have had a bad cold ___ the last two weeks.
items.uz: So'nggi ikki hafta davomida qattiq shamollab yuribman.

items.sentence: That student has a good career ___ of him.
items.uz: U talabaning oldinda yaxshi karyerasi bor.

items.sentence: My doctor wrote ___ the medicines I had to buy.
items.uz: Shifokorim sotib olishim kerak bo'lgan dorilarni yozib berdi.

items.sentence: John had chickenpox and had spots all ___ his body.
items.uz: Jon suvchechak bilan kasallandi va butun tanasida toshmalar bor edi.

items.sentence: Make sure you keep all medicines away ___ children.
items.uz: Barcha dorilarni bolalardan uzoq tutishga ishonch hosil qiling.

items.sentence: The nurse comes ___ duty at ten o'clock.
The scientists are doing research ___ the causes of cancer.
items.uz: Olimlar saraton sabablari bo'yicha tadqiqot olib borishyapti.

exercises.instructionEn: What's wrong with each person? Match the prompts to the pictures, then use them to write short dialogues, as in the example: get/toothache, burn/finger, break/leg, catch/cold, get/stomach ache, get/cough. Pictures: 1 woman coughing; 2 man ironing, burnt finger; 3 man in armchair, leg in plaster; 4 woman holding her stomach; 5 man holding his cheek; 6 woman with a tissue. Example: A: What's wrong? B: I've got a cough.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir odamga nima bo'lgan? Ko'rsatmalarni rasmlarga moslang, so'ng ular bilan qisqa dialoglar yozing, namunadagidek: get/toothache, burn/finger, break/leg, catch/cold, get/stomach ache, get/cough. Rasmlar: 1 yo'talayotgan ayol; 2 dazmol qilayotgan erkak, barmog'i kuygan; 3 kresloda oyog'i gipsdagi erkak; 4 qornini ushlagan ayol; 5 jag'ini ushlagan erkak; 6 ro'molchali ayol. Namuna: A: Nima bo'ldi? B: Yo'talyapman.
exercises.explanationUz:
KASALLIKLAR - 'WHAT'S WRONG?'
  (coursebook 49-bet 8-mashq).

  QOLIP:
  A: What's wrong?
  B: I've + V3 + ... (present
     perfect - natija hozir).

  'I've GOT a cough / toothache /
    stomach ache' (have got)
  'I've BURNT my finger'
  'I've BROKEN my leg'
  'I've CAUGHT a cold'


⚠ PRESENT PERFECT (coursebook
  49-bet qoidasi):

  have + V3: burn → burnt, break →
  broken, catch → caught, get →
  got.


⚠ 'TOOTHACHE', 'STOMACH ACHE':

  'ache' = og'riq. toothache (bitta
  so'z), stomach ache (ikki so'z),
  headache.


⚠ 'TO CATCH A COLD':

  = shamollab qolmoq ('catch'
  bilan!).


⚠ 'A COUGH':

  = yo'tal. /kɒf/.

items.question: What's wrong?
items.whyUz: ⚠ catch → CAUGHT. 'catch a cold' = shamollab qolmoq.
